arguments.value: TransMontaigne Management Company, LLC and TLP Management Services, LLC entered into this agreement, effective August __, 2019. Under the agreement, TransMontaigne Management Company, LLC will provide management, operational, and administrative services for TLP Management Services, LLC and its affiliates using its employees, and TLP Management Services, LLC will reimburse all related direct and indirect costs, including salaries, benefits, taxes, severance, and employee-related claims. TLP Management Services, LLC must also pay an additional fee equal to 1% of the reimbursed amount. The parties may settle payments through their normal intercompany settlement process. The agreement continues until terminated; either party may end it by written agreement or by giving 5 days’ written notice, and payment obligations survive termination. The agreement is governed by Colorado law, with disputes in Colorado courts, and can only be changed in writing.
